pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Basic (Free): $0 per user per month… limited meeting history… Business: $14 per user per month… unlimited meeting notes and history… Enterprise: $35 per user per month… Previous 'Pro' or 'Individual' plans around $18 are out of date, as both solo tiers were retired in the 2026 restructure."

nl.tagline: AI-notitieblok voor meetings, zonder bot in het gesprek
nl.description: Granola neemt vergaderingen op via je computer (zonder zichtbare bot), combineert het transcript met je eigen aantekeningen en maakt nette notities. Je kunt vragen stellen over eerdere meetings en notities delen met je team of CRM.
bestFor: Wie geen notulistbot in gesprekken wil
Founders en consultants met veel calls

en.tagline: AI notepad for meetings, with no bot joining the call
en.description: Granola records meetings through your computer (no visible bot), combines the transcript with your own notes and produces clean meeting notes. You can query past meetings and share notes with your team or CRM.
bestFor: People who don't want a notetaker bot in calls
Founders and consultants with many calls
notFor: People who want to rewatch full recordings
limitations: Free plan has limited meeting history
